name: robots/vimalabs__vimabench
title: VIMA-Bench multimodal robot manipulation benchmark (PyBullet)
intro: VIMA-Bench multimodal robot manipulation benchmark (PyBullet), adapted from vimalabs/vimabench. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 3 more; runs `step`, `reset_world` and `seed_world`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
